the determination of thermodynamical quantities of the quark gluon plasma from lattice QCD simulations.
the study of the QCD phase transition and the quark-gluon plasma, in particular the study of fluctuations of conserved charges, such as net baryon number, electric charge, and strangeness.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have found no evidence for a first order phase transition in the chiral limit, and that the transition is of the crossover type.
we find the scaling regime to be reached for all observables, but the scaling violations are large enough to be of concern.
we find a clear signal for a non-vanishing strange quark number susceptibility at zero temperature, and that this quantity is enhanced in the deconfined phase.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we observe a clear signal for a non-vanishing non-diagonal quenching factor at high temperatures.
the non-diagonal quarks number susceptibilities are not small, but of the same order as the diagonal ones.
